newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 2.84 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 2.84 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 2.27 points, or 2.84 percent up at 82.33 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index provisionally rose 112.04 points to 3,539.05.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 18.04 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
